title: gpbiometricspy: Python tools for Gazepoint biometric workflows
description: gpbiometricspy is the Python counterpart of gpbiometrics, with gpbiometrics 2.0.0 frozen as its initial semantic reference. It provides Gazepoint-native workflows for EDA/GSR/SCR, PPG/HRV, pupil, gaze, fixation, AOI, TTL/event alignment, multimodal quality control, analysis, plotting, reporting, simulation, reproducibility, and interoperability. Version 0.1.8 preserves the complete 406-export scientific contract, freezes 874 passing exact-main tests and 15,612/15,612 covered statements, retains 7,315/7,334 = 99.7409% raw branch coverage with exactly 19 reviewed residual arcs and zero unexpected, stale, or unaudited branch debt, and adds the Python-native PPG pigmentation / measurement-equity audit with deterministic synthetic evidence plus an authorized STEP wearable-heart-rate execution. STEP Fitzpatrick phototype is treated as subjective categorical provenance only; ENCoDE remains deferred and no clinical SpO2 validation is claimed.
